name: Ask Her Out
source:
A perfectly healthy and adequately normal conversation amongst friends turns into something else entirely.

[From [url=https://butchersboy.itch.io/ask-her-out]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
朋友間一場健健康康、再正常不過的談話，逐漸變成了完全不同的一回事。

（來源：[url=https://butchersboy.itch.io/ask-her-out]itch.io[/url]）
